$description: Mode-independent tokens. DTCG 2025.10 (ADR-001). Source of truth — emits src/styles/tokens.css + src/tokens.ts via `npm run tokens`. DO NOT hand-write CSS variables.

radius.$description: Base corner radius. The step scale below is authored explicitly rather than derived with calc() in CSS — Figma Variables cannot express calc(), so a derived scale would exist in CSS only and Figma would need hand-entered numbers that silently drift. Explicit steps keep one source for both.

font-mono.$description: Monospace stack for code and tabular figures.
